f-2: City of Promise is Charlottesville's hub for dual-generation early intervention, focused on literacy and chronic absenteeism. We equip children and families with the support, coaching, and whole-family tools and resources they deserve, because education is a social issue that no school can solve alone, and every kid deserves to learn to read.
f-6: Did you know that Charlottesville City Schools has the largest Black–white literacy pass-rate gap in Virginia, despite boasting the second highest instructional cost-per-pupil? The school's are well funded. The students are not. And these students bring their whole worlds with them into the buildings every day, impacting their ability to interact with curriculum.

f-25: The parent-focused arm of our model. Parenting coaching, school advocacy, resource brokering, because a child's trajectory is heavily influenced by their parent's.
